svg.text: Figure 1. Architecture of the Brief A phone agent (workflow v52): 40 steps in six phases
One box per step, read top to bottom in call order. Routes carry the flow; the model only speaks in the five conversation steps.
= pre/post action on the step, or pre/post process code on its tools
= an extracted or stored value matched;
= the agent called a tool that ends the step. Conversation steps show their tool count.
Design rule: dates, counters, joins and the outcome live in code steps and hooks; routes carry the flow; the model only speaks.
